about_the_game:
Tame-a-goat-chi is a relaxing and irresistibly cute goat-tending game designed to run right next to your tasks. Whether you're answering emails or watching videos, your goats are always just a glance away.

Start with a small pasture and a handful of goats, each with their own needs, moods, and personalities. Satisfy their thirst, hunger, and playfulness to keep them happy—and watch as they reward you with coins and affection!

Upgrade your farm, unlock new goat breeds with unique traits, and plant crops to support your growing herd. Want to boost your income? Play quick mini-games or join seasonal events to cheer up your goats and increase productivity.

🌿 Key Features

  • 🐐 Half-screen experience – Perfect for side play during work or study

  • 🌱 Farm & feed – Expand your farm and grow treats for your goats

  • 💰 Idle coin generation – Happy goats drop coins automatically

  • 🎮 Mini-games & events – Light interactive content for bonuses

  • 🎨 Charming art & sound – Soft visuals and cozy feedback

  • 🛒 Goat store – Unlock quirky new goats with different strengths

  • 🧠 Smart systems – Message alerts, tutorials, and satisfaction loops

Whether you're a hardcore multitasker or just need a tiny pasture to calm your day, Tame-a-goat-chi is the goat-sized dose of joy you didn’t know you needed.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or later
  • Processor: Intel Core I5-9400F or Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 12 compatible GPU, GeForce GTX 1050Ti / Radeon RX 570
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10600K or Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 12 compatible GPU, GeForce GTX 3060 / Radeon RX Vega 56
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: Run your own adorable goat pasture in this half-screen idle game! Tame, feed and care for quirky goats while growing your farm – all while you work or browse the web!
supported_languages:
English*, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese, Portuguese - Portugal
*languages with full audio support
